en: \bTupp: Yo, I'm going to make this punk pay for the way he made me feel back when we were kids. Get ready.

en: \bIlima: Thanks for your help. I didn't really need it, but it's nice to see an act of kindness. Let me repay you.

id: \rYou want to study here? Why, that's a wonderful idea. I guess we can head home without you.
en: \rYou want to study here? Why, that's a wonderful idea. I guess we can head home without you.

id: \rMom: I guess we can head home without you.
en: \rMom: I guess we can head home without you.

en: \bKukui: Don't worry about him \PN. I'll take care of it.

id: \bThe All-Out Brothers will win!
en: \bThe All-Out Brothers will win!
it: \bI Fratelli Senza Freni vinceranno!

id: \bThe Alola Champion is awesome!
en: \bThe Alola Champion is awesome!
it: \bIl Campione di Alola è fantastico!

id: \bThe forest is scary. Only students are allowed in here.
en: \bThe forest is scary. Only students are allowed in here.

id: You are about to enter a battle with a legendary that will be unobtainable until the post game if it is not caught here. Save?
en: You are about to enter a battle with a legendary that will be unobtainable until the post game if it is not caught here. Save?
it: Stai per affrontare un Pokémon leggendario che, se non lo catturi qui, non sarà ottenibile fino al post-game. Vuoi salvare?

id: \bIlima: Thanks for your help. I didn't really need it, but it's nice to see an act of kindness. I'm a graduate of this school. I came back to speak with Kukui.
en: \bIlima: Thanks for your help. I didn't really need it, but it's nice to see an act of kindness. I'm a graduate of this school. I came back to speak with Kukui.
it: \bIlima: Grazie per l'aiuto. Non ne avevo davvero bisogno, ma è bello vedere un gesto gentile. Mi sono diplomato in questa scuola. Sono tornato per parlare con Kukui.

id: \bHe informs me an Alola League is being set up. Having tried the Kalos League, I'm looking forward to it.
en: \bHe informs me an Alola League is being set up.  Having tried the Kalos League, I'm looking forward to it.
it: \bMi ha detto che stanno organizzando una Lega di Alola.  Avendo già provato la Lega di Kalos, non vedo l'ora.

id: Rotom Dex: That didn't take too long. Time to go home.
en: Rotom Dex: That didn't take too long. Time to go home.
it: Rotom Dex: Non ci è voluto molto. Ora di tornare a casa.

id: \rMom: Oh \PN, doesn't this place look amazing? I'm going to go explore. Don't forget to drop off that egg.
en: \rMom: Oh \PN, doesn't this place look amazing? I'm going to go explore. Don't forget to drop off that egg.
it: \rMamma: Oh \PN, questo posto non è stupendo? Vado a esplorare. Non dimenticare di consegnare quell'uovo.

id: \bKukui: So, you've come to battle me because I decided to start the Alola Pokémon League.
en: \bKukui: So, you've come to battle me because I decided to start the Alola Pokémon League.
it: \bKukui: Quindi sei venuto a sfidarmi perché ho deciso di fondare la Lega Pokémon di Alola.

id: \bGuzma: You think too small. I've come to destroy you. You think replacing old customs will be a good idea?
en: \bGuzma: You think too small. I've come to destroy you. You think replacing old customs will be a good idea?
it: \bGuzman: Pensi troppo in piccolo. Sono venuto a distruggerti. Credi davvero che sostituire le vecchie usanze sia una buona idea?

id: \bBut a League? That's a waste of time. Everybody already knows who the strongest Trainer is.
en: \bBut a League? That's a waste of time. Everybody already knows who the strongest Trainer is.
it: \bMa una Lega? È una perdita di tempo. Tutti sanno già chi è l'Allenatore più forte.

id: \bKukui: If you think that join the league and prove it in battle.
en: \bKukui: If you think that join the league and prove it in battle.
it: \bKukui: Se ne sei convinto, iscriviti alla Lega e dimostralo in battaglia.

id: \bGuzma: Like I'd fall for that trick. I'll beat you right here, and if you still make the league, I'll destroy that too.
en: \bGuzma: Like I'd fall for that trick. I'll beat you right here, and if you still make the league, I'll destroy that too.
it: \bGuzman: Come se ci cascassi. Ti batterò qui e subito, e se riuscirai comunque a creare la Lega, distruggerò anche quella.

id: \bWhat's the matter kid? Think I'm being too hard on him? Fine, I'll take you down first. I could use a warm up.
en: \bWhat's the matter kid? Think I'm being too hard on him? Fine, I'll take you down first. I could use a warm up.
it: \bChe c'è, ragazzino? Pensi che ci vada giù troppo pesante con lui? E va bene, comincerò da te. Un riscaldamento mi farà comodo.

id: \bGuzma: You call that a challenge? If this is the best one of your students can do then the whole league is going to be a joke. I'll just crush you there.
en: \bGuzma: You call that a challenge? If this is the best one of your students can do then the whole league is going to be a joke. I'll just crush you there.
it: \bGuzman: E questa la chiami una sfida? Se questo è il meglio che sa fare uno dei tuoi studenti, la Lega sarà una barzelletta. Vi stritolerò tutti lì.

id: \rLana: I'm going to fish up the biggest Pokémon. Just wait and see.
en: \rLana: I'm going to fish up the biggest Pokémon. Just wait and see.
it: \rSuiren: Pescherò il Pokémon più grosso di tutti. Aspetta e vedrai.

id: \rLana: Hi \PN. You just missed my new friend, Dewpider. I didn't catch it though.
en: \rLana: Hi \PN. You just missed my new friend, Dewpider. I didn't catch it though.
it: \rSuiren: Ciao \PN. Hai appena perso il mio nuovo amico, Dewpider. Però non l'ho catturato.

id: Rotom Dex: Mallow will be in her dad's shop in Hau'oli City.
en: Rotom Dex: Mallow will be in her dad's shop in Hau'oli City.
it: Rotom Dex: Ibis sarà nel negozio di suo padre a Hau'oli.

id: \rLana: Let's battle again soon. I know you like it.
en: \rLana: Let's battle again soon. I know you like it.

en: \bSophocles: Don't bother me right now. I'm working on something important.

en: \rYou're the new student? The school isn't this way.

en: \bKukui: You didn't have to step in there; I could have handled him. Keep your eyes open. I doubt that's the last we'll see of Guzma.
